name: lead-enrichment
description: Verify email lists at any scale with the Caeros enrichment engine: MillionVerifier and BounceBan, preview-first spend gates, cached verdicts, CSV export.

interface.shortDescription: Verify email lists server-side: preview a sample, launch a run, export the clean CSV.
interface.longDescription: Teaches Caeros agents the gateway enrichment engine: verify one email or a million, always preview a 10-address sample before spending provider credits, poll run counters instead of rows, and export results as CSV. Verdicts are normalized to deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown across MillionVerifier and BounceBan, results are cached for 30 days so re-runs are free, and syntactically invalid addresses are rejected locally at zero cost. Runs execute fully server-side and survive disconnects; provider API keys stay on the gateway and never reach the client.
defaultPrompt: Verify these emails and tell me which are safe to send to
Clean my lead list: run a sample preview first, then verify the rest
Export a CSV of the deliverable addresses from my last verification run
